summary: The UserAccessHistory class is a part of the HSPnet.UserControls.StaffProfile namespace, serving as a user control for managing user access history. It provides a user interface including controls like pnlButtons, btnPrintDetails, and gridData to display user access data. It interacts with the HSPnetSession to manage user sessions and uses data-bindings to object sources like dsStaffPRHistoryList.
purpose: To present and manage user access history within the HSPnet application framework, enabling administrators to view and manage historical data related to user activities.

workflows.name: Display User Access History
steps: Bind data to gridData control using dsStaffPRHistoryList.
Render UI components like pnlButtons and btnPrintDetails for user interaction.

system_behavior: Displays user access history in a grid format.
Allows exporting or printing of access details.
